item.title: NY court dismissed a foreclosure case after the lender waited three years to seek a default ruling
item.description: In a significant ruling, a New York appeals court has supported the dismissal of a mortgage foreclosure lawsuit against a borrower after the lender delayed three years to seek a default judgment. New York regulations stipulate that lenders must act within one year of a borrower's non-response to avoid case dismissal. This decision reinforces homeowner protections and emphasizes the importance of timely legal actions in foreclosure matters. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.description: A remarkable scrapbook assembled by Hilda Jeanne Payin in the 1930s was auctioned for an impressive $28,759. This unique collection boasts over 200 signatures from iconic figures across sports, politics, and entertainment, including legends like Babe Ruth and Amelia Earhart, as well as presidents Calvin Coolidge and Herbert Hoover. item.title: Tifón Champi golpea con fuerza: miles de evacuados y cortes de electricidad en Taiwan
item.description: El tifón Champi, con fuertes vientos y condiciones meteorológicas extremas, ha dejado más de 55 mil hogares sin electricidad y al menos cinco mil personas evacuadas en Taiwan. Los vientos alcanzaron 176 kilómetros por hora, un fenómeno amplificado por el Fenómeno de El Niño. El tifón se aleja de las costas de Taiwan y se acerca a China y Japón, países que ya reportan fuertes vientos y lluvias en la zona sur. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Guatemala queda última en Latinoamérica en las pruebas PISA: ¿por qué?

Autoridades educativas señalan factores como las desigualdades sociales y las limitaciones del sistema educativo como algunos de los factores. Para hacer frente a la situación, el Gobierno propone cambios curriculares, formación de nuevos maestros y transformación digital. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: France: Protests continue while police fire tear gas at demonstrators
item.description: A total of 410,000 people took part in demonstrations across France on Saturday – including 110,000 in Paris – as part of a day of rallies focussed on purchasing power and the defence of public services, the Interior Ministry told AFP. The turnout was slightly lower than last week, which saw 550,000 people take to the streets. Meanwhile, according to the union responsible for organising the authorised events, 800,000 people participated in the demonstrations nationwide on Saturday, with 250,000 in the capital. Clashes broke out in several cities, including Paris, Lyon, Rennes, Nantes… Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: In 2016, a Texas couple took in 2 goats in their tiny South Austin backyard; 10 years later, Austin Farm Sanctuary covers 95 acres
item.description: In 2016, Chris Fuller-Wigg and Angela established the Austin Farm Sanctuary after rescuing a pair of goats, marking the beginning of a transformative journey. Today, the sanctuary spans 95 acres and shelters around 240 animals, many of whom are elderly or disabled. With its innovative LEAP program, visitors engage in hands-on experiences that foster compassion for farm animals, challenging traditional views and promoting a kinder perspective on these sentient beings.
